title: Existing Models
description: Existing Models includes existing H&H models, such as hydraulic, hydrologic, and reservoir-operations models, to be used as reference during FFRD model development. Sources may include the Corps Water Management System (CWMS) modeling effort, USACE District Models, High-Level Risk Assessments, FEMA models, and other local and Federal agencies; additional model sources beyond these are likely. All models should include associated documentation, reporting, and metadata. Non-model FEMA data and reports are saved separately in FEMA.
